berichten.samenvatting: Alternatives to animal-sourced foods (Alt-ASFs) are processed plant-based products that mimic animal-sourced foods. berichten.titel: Case report: long-term clinical remission of food-responsive enteropathy in a dog fed a yellow mealworm-based diet
berichten.samenvatting: Food-responsive enteropathy (FRE) is the most common form of canine chronic inflammatory enteropathy. Novel protein diets constitute first-line therapy, and many dogs have already been exposed to "novel" meat alternatives. Edible insects are a novel, highly digestible, and sustainable protein source. In the present study, a five-year-old male York-shire Terrier with chronic FRE and gallbladder sludge was transitioned to a diet with a 35% inclusion level of Tenebrio molitor larvae meal.
berichten.kernzin: Een Yorkshire Terriër met chronische enteropathie herstelde langdurig nadat hij werd overgeschakeld op een dieet op basis van meelwormen.

berichten.titel: Maternal and childhood plant-based diets with brain morphology and cognitive performance in adolescence
berichten.samenvatting: Plant-based diets (PBDs) are increasingly discussed in the context of sustainable and healthy eating. However, evidence on PBDs during early pregnancy and childhood in relation to brain morphology and cognitive performance remains largely unknown. We aimed to investigate whether maternal and childhood overall, healthful, and unhealthful PBDs are associated with offspring brain morphology and adolescent cognitive performance.
berichten.kernzin: Onderzoekers onderzoeken het verband tussen plantaardige diëten tijdens de zwangerschap en kinderjaren en de hersenmorfologie en cognitieve prestaties in de adolescentie.

berichten.titel: A US-Based Epidemiological Analysis Reveals Large Discordance Between Exclusive Dietary Recall-Based Vegetarian Status Assessment and Self-Identification in a Nationally Representative Population-Based Survey
berichten.samenvatting: The greater the flexibility in definitions and concepts, the less likely research findings are to be true. Vegetarian status assessment in epidemiological research is a matter of ongoing controversy, and reported vegetarian prevalence is highly variable depending on the employed assessment methods. A systematic comparison of these potential vegetarian status assessment methods is currently unavailable.
berichten.kernzin: Een Amerikaanse epidemiologische analyse onthult een grote discrepantie tussen dieet-herkenning en vegetarische zelfidentificatie.

berichten.titel: Investigating the Relationship Between Hoof, Liver, and Cardiac Abnormalities in Bos taurus Grain-Fed Beef Cattle < 30 Months in a Natural Program with No Antibiotics or Growth Promotants
berichten.samenvatting: Our primary objective was to determine the relationship between hoof, liver, and cardiac abnormalities in a group of natural-fed cattle at slaughter. Bos taurus beef cattle (N = 1312), without dairy phenotype, were evaluated for abnormalities at a slaughter establishment in the Great Plains region of the United States (elevation: 563 m). Cattle were enrolled in a vegetarian-fed program that prohibited implants, diet-included hormones, and beta-adrenergic agonists. Generalized linear mixed models were used to determine the prevalence of each abnormality within other abnormalities.
berichten.kernzin: Onderzoekers onderzochten de relatie tussen hoef-, lever- en hartafwijkingen bij slachtvee in de Verenigde Staten.
berichten.uitgever: Animals : an open access journal from MDPI

berichten.titel: Associations of Distinct Dietary Indices with Global and Domain-Specific Cognition and Age-Related Heterogeneity in Older Chinese Adults
berichten.samenvatting: Whether distinct dietary indices are similarly associated with cognitive domains and whether these associations vary by age remain unclear. We examined the Chinese MIND diet score (cMIND), dietary diversity score, and healthy plant-based diet index (HPDI) in relation to cognition among older Chinese adults. This cross-sectional study included 9615 adults aged 65 years or older from the 2021 Chinese Longitudinal Healthy Longevity Survey. Global cognition and four cognitive domains were assessed using the Chinese Mini-Mental State Examination.
berichten.kernzin: Een studie onderzocht het verband tussen verschillende voedingsindexen, waaronder een plantaardig dieet, en cognitie bij oudere Chinezen.

berichten.titel: Differences in Serum Cytokine Profiles Between Vegetarians and Omnivores: Exploratory Assessment of Dietary Factors
berichten.samenvatting: Background/Objectives: Evidence suggests that plant-based diets are associated with reduced risk of chronic inflammatory diseases and lower circulating C-reactive protein (CRP) levels. However, associations with other inflammatory biomarkers, including interleukins (ILs), tumor necrosis factors (TNFs), interferons (IFNs), and chemokines, remain limited and inconclusive. This study compared multiple serum cytokine and chemokine levels between healthy vegetarians and omnivores.
berichten.kernzin: Een studie vergeleek serumcytokineprofielen en ontstekingsbiomarkers tussen gezonde vegetariërs en omnivoren.

berichten.titel: Extrusion-Structured Plant-Based Meat Analogs: Factors Governing Texture and Quality
berichten.samenvatting: Plant-based meat analogs (PBMAs) have attracted increasing attention as sustainable alternatives to animal meat, with extrusion becoming the most widely used structuring technology for their production. This review summarizes recent advances in extrusion-structured PBMAs, with particular emphasis on low- and high-moisture extrusion cooking, by integrating evidence from a broad range of peer-reviewed studies and reviews spanning foundational research to recent developments.
berichten.kernzin: Een overzichtsstudie vat recente ontwikkelingen samen in extrusietechnologie voor de productie van plantaardige vleesvervangers.

berichten.titel: A plant-based diet attenuates hypertension-induced renal and hepatic stress: an exploratory study
berichten.samenvatting: Hypertension drives progressive renal dysfunction and hepatic injury. In this secondary analysis, we investigated whether a plant-based diet (PBD) could prevent and/or reverse hypertension-induced renal and hepatic insult. Four-week-old female spontaneously hypertensive rats (SHRs) consumed a refined control diet or PBD comprising 28% fruits, vegetables, nuts and legumes, while normotensive Wistar-Kyoto rats consumed the control diet. After 24 weeks, a subset of control-fed SHRs switched to PBD for 12 weeks.
berichten.kernzin: Een studie onderzocht of een plantaardig dieet hypertensie-geïnduceerde nier- en leverstress bij ratten kan verminderen.

berichten.titel: Social Dynamics Are Associated with Plant-Based Dietary Consumption Patterns Among Rural Adults in the U.S
berichten.samenvatting: Social dynamics are known to influence eating behaviors and differ across geographic contexts. Some evidence suggests healthy plant-based diets (PBDs) are associated with reduced risk of chronic diseases, morbidity and mortality, and have lower environmental burdens. This paper examines the role of social influence, expectations, and pressures in consumption of PBDs among rural residents in the United States, with attention to gender differences.
berichten.kernzin: Een studie onderzocht de invloed van sociale dynamiek op de consumptie van plantaardige diëten onder plattelandsbewoners in de Verenigde Staten.

berichten.titel: Dietary Polyphenol Intake Inversely Associates with Fibrosis Scores in Individuals with MASLD
berichten.samenvatting: Background & aims. Plant-based dietary patterns, such as the Mediterranean diet, are considered protective against MASLD. The Mediterranean diet is rich in polyphenols (PP), plant-derived metabolites that exhibit anti-fibrotic effects in experimental models. This study aimed to evaluate the association between dietary polyphenol intake and fibrosis scores in patients with MASLD. Methods. The study population comprised two retrospective cohorts, MICOL and NUTRIHEP, from southern Italy.
berichten.kernzin: Een studie onderzocht het verband tussen de inname van polyfenolen uit plantaardige voeding en fibrosescores bij patiënten met MASLD in Italië.

berichten.titel: Association of the Schizophrenia Risk Locus rs10866912 with Cerebral Volumes, Diet, and Psychosis in the UK Biobank
berichten.samenvatting: Leading schizophrenia GWAS signals require evaluation of their pathological significance across diverse ancestries. rs10866912 reached genome-wide significance in our Indian ancestry GWAS of schizophrenia; its risk allele reduces expression of NAPRT, the rate-limiting enzyme in the brain's principal NAD+-synthesis pathway, giving a single mechanistic basis for testing associations with brain structure, dietary niacin intake, and psychosis risk.
berichten.kernzin: Onderzoekers analyseerden het verband tussen het schizofrenierisicogen rs10866912, hersenvolumes, dieet en psychose in de UK Biobank.

berichten.titel: Beyond Protein Restriction: Comparative eADI-17-Estimated Anti-Inflammatory Profiles of Four Renal Diets
berichten.samenvatting: Chronic low-grade inflammation contributes to chronic kidney disease (CKD) progression and cardiovascular complications. Although nutritional therapy is central to CKD management, the estimated anti-inflammatory profiles of renal diets remain poorly characterized. We analyzed 40 daily menus with broadly comparable, although not identical, energy content (10 per dietary pattern): Mediterranean renal diet (MedRen; 0.8 g protein/kg), vegan diet (0.7 g/kg), conventional low-protein diet (LPD; 0.6 g/kg), and supplemented very-low-protein diet (sVLPD; 0.3 g/kg).
berichten.kernzin: Een onderzoek vergeleek de ontstekingsremmende profielen van vier verschillende niëndiëten, waaronder een veganistisch dieet.

berichten.titel: Korean Buddhist Temple Food: A Traditional Plant-Based Dietary Pattern Linking Gut Microbiota, Metabolic Health, and Mindful Living
berichten.samenvatting: Korean Buddhist temple food represents a traditional plant-based dietary practice rooted in Korean Buddhist monastic traditions and characterized by an emphasis on seasonal and minimally processed plant foods. Traditional temple-food practices generally exclude pungent vegetables-such as garlic, green onion, chives, wild garlic, and asafoetida-and incorporate a variety of plant-based ingredients and fermented foods, such as fermented soybean paste (doenjang), soy sauce (ganjang), fermented red chili paste (gochujang), fermented soybean paste (cheonggukjang), and fermented vegetables (kimchi).
berichten.kernzin: Koreaanse boeddhistische tempelvoeding is een traditioneel plantaardig dieet gekenmerkt door seizoensgebonden en minimaal bewerkte ingrediënten.

berichten.titel: Food-Derived Umami Peptides: Linking Candidate Discovery, Experimental Validation, and Food Applications
berichten.samenvatting: Alternative proteins and cultivated meat increase the need for flavour strategies that maintain savoury quality with less reliance on salt and conventional seasonings. Food-derived umami peptides are promising candidates, but their practical value depends on evidence beyond sequence prediction. With advances in virtual digestion, peptidomics, and AI-assisted approaches, discovery is expanding from sensory-guided preparation toward candidate-library construction and data-driven prioritization.
berichten.kernzin: De opkomst van alternatieve eiwitten en kweekvlees vergroot de vraag naar smaakstrategieën zoals umami-peptides om de hartige smaak te behouden.

berichten.titel: Improved long-term proliferation and myogenic differentiation of bovine muscle stem cells through CDKN2A gene editing
berichten.samenvatting: The production of cultured meat is constrained by the limited proliferation and differentiation capacity of seed cells. Here, we report that prolonged in vitro culture induces cellular senescence in bovine muscle stem cells (bMuSCs), impairing their proliferative and myogenic potential. We then examined the expression of cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitors (CKIs) and found that CDKN2A expression was markedly upregulated during passaging and its knockout substantially enhanced the expansion of bMuSCs.
berichten.kernzin: Onderzoekers verbeterden de proliferatie en myogene differentiatie van boviene spierstamcellen voor kweekvlees door CDKN2A-genbewerking.

berichten.titel: Evidence Suggests Linoleic Acid Exerts Health Benefits Beyond Cardiovascular Disease: A Brief Review of Clinical and Observational Studies
berichten.samenvatting: Questions challenging the healthfulness of diets high in linoleic acid (LA) and seed oils, which are major sources of this essential fatty acid, have recently arisen. These questions are especially relevant to adherents of plant-based diets as their LA intake is higher than the general population. Some maintain that LA increases inflammation and oxidative stress and for these reasons, despite its ability to lower circulating LDL-cholesterol levels when replacing saturated fat, does not lower cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk.
berichten.kernzin: Een overzichtsstudie onderzocht de gezondheidseffecten van linolzuur en zaadoliën, die in grote mate aanwezig zijn in plantaardige diëten.

berichten.titel: Phytase-loaded core-shell microparticles for enzyme stabilization using ethanol anti-solvent precipitation
berichten.samenvatting: In plant-based diets, phytate reduces the adsorption of minerals. Fortifying foods with phytase can improve mineral bioavailability by hydrolyzing phytate. However, phytase is susceptible to environmental stress such as heat and acidic conditions encountered during food processing. A core-shell microparticle composed of a phytase-chitosan core and a shell consisting of cross-linked alginate-κ-carrageenan was developed using ethanol anti-solvent precipitation.
berichten.kernzin: Onderzoekers ontwikkelden fytase-geladen kern-schil micropartikels om de biologische beschikbaarheid van mineralen in plantaardige diëten te verbeteren.

berichten.titel: Application of dual-marker DNA metabarcoding to verify label accuracy in plant-based protein foods
berichten.samenvatting: The global market for plant-based protein foods is rapidly expanding; however, complex supply chains and multi-step processing pose substantial traceability challenges. This study applied DNA metabarcoding to identify plant-derived ingredients in plant-based protein foods, involving the amplification and sequencing of short DNA marker fragments. To enhance the efficiency of species detection, a dual-marker approach using ITS2 and trnL(UAA) was applied to analyze a mock mixed library containing 37 confirmed species.
berichten.kernzin: Onderzoekers paste DNA-metabarcoding toe om de nauwkeurigheid van etiketten op plantaardige eiwitproducten te verifiëren.

berichten.titel: Potential Biodiversity Footprint Reductions from Intended Shifts to Plant-Based Meals
berichten.samenvatting: Adopting plant-based diets can mitigate biodiversity loss by reducing the demand for land required for feed and livestock. Yet, most assessments rely on hypothetical dietary scenarios that potentially overestimate biodiversity gains. We conducted a large-scale consumer survey across three countries (NLD, GBR, and USA) and estimated the biodiversity footprints of current and intended future diets using the loss of mean species abundance (MSA-loss) and the loss of global species richness (RSR-loss) as indicators.
berichten.kernzin: Een grootschalig consumentenonderzoek in drie landen schatte de mogelijke vermindering van de biodiversiteitsvoetafdruk door een overstap op plantaardige maaltijden.

berichten.titel: Integrated Transcriptomic-Proteomic Profiling Identifies Candidate Regulators of Stemness Maintenance in Skeletal Muscle Satellite Cells
berichten.samenvatting: Cultured meat is recognized as a sustainable alternative to animal products, but the gradual stemness loss in seed cells during in vitro culture remains a challenge for industrialization. Here, we isolated chicken embryonic skeletal muscle satellite cells and observed a pronounced decline in stemness following the third passage.
berichten.kernzin: Onderzoekers analyseerden kippenspierstamcellen om factoren te vinden die de stamcelcapaciteit voor kweekvlees behouden.
berichten.uitgever: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry

berichten.titel: QUALITY OF PROTEIN IN DIFFERENT FOOD SOURCES IN THE CONTEXT OF CHRONIC KIDNEY DISEASE
berichten.samenvatting: Plant-based diets have gained increasing attention in the management of chronic kidney disease (CKD), yet concerns persist regarding the quality of plant-derived proteins. Traditionally, animal-based proteins have been regarded as high biological value proteins, while plant proteins have been labeled as low biological value, contributing to misconceptions about their nutritional adequacy.
berichten.kernzin: Een overzichtsartikel bespreekt de kwaliteit van plantaardige eiwitten in de context van chronische nierziekte.
berichten.uitgever: Journal of renal nutrition : the official journal of the Council on Renal Nutrition of the National Kidney Foundation

berichten.titel: From bioreactor to table: reinventing future protein supply through cellular agriculture
berichten.samenvatting: Confronted with the severe environmental pressures, resource constraints, and ethical concerns of conventional animal husbandry, cellular agriculture has emerged as a revolutionary paradigm aiming to reshape the global food supply chain by producing meat, dairy, and eggs directly in controlled environments. This review systematically examines the two core pathways of this field, cell-cultured meat and precision fermentation, by outlining their technological advancements, industrialization challenges, and future prospects.
berichten.kernzin: Een overzichtsstudie onderzoekt kweekvlees en precisiefermentatie als alternatieven voor conventionele dierlijke landbouw.

berichten.titel: Synthesis and Characterization of Naringin Phenolate Salts for Cultivated Meat
berichten.samenvatting: The high cost of growth factors has limited the commercial-scale production of cultivated meat products. In this study, we report on the synthesis and characterization of a series of naringin phenolate salts. Phenolate salts with sodium (Na+), potassium (K+), calcium (Ca2+), and tetrabutylammonium (TBA+) counterions were prepared to introduce water solubility to the natural flavonoid naringin. The synthesized salts were comprehensively characterized to confirm their chemical structures. Solvated cations were examined for their effect on the salts' physicochemical and biological properties.
berichten.kernzin: Wetenschappers synthetiseerden naringine-fenolaatzouten om de productiekosten van kweekvlees te verlagen.
berichten.uitgever: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry

berichten.titel: Plant Protein-Based Scaffolds for Cultivated Meat Production: A Review
berichten.samenvatting: This review summarises recent progress in the development of plant protein-based scaffolds for cultivated meat production, with a particular focus on protein sources derived from major agricultural crops and their processing into functional biomaterials. We discuss how protein extraction strategies, as well as emerging technologies, influence protein purity, functionality and suitability for scaffold fabrication.
berichten.kernzin: Een literatuurstudie vat de vooruitgang samen in plantaardige eiwitstructuren voor de productie van kweekvlees.

berichten.titel: Vitamin B12 Biofortification in Edible Plants: Opportunities and Limitations from Soil-Based to Controlled Cultivation Systems
berichten.samenvatting: Vitamin B12 is largely absent from edible plants, increasing the risk of deficiency as plant-based diets became more prevalent worldwide. This review summarizes current strategies for vitamin B12 biofortification in plants, including the use of organic fertilizers, biofertilizers, hydroponics, aeroponics, foliar applications, and seed-based approaches. It also examines soil dynamics, microbial interactions, and other factors that influence vitamin B12 uptake and accumulation.
berichten.kernzin: Een overzichtsartikel onderzoekt strategieën om eetbare planten te verrijken met vitamine B12 voor plantaardige diëten.
berichten.uitgever: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry

berichten.titel: Efficacy of yeast mannan supplementation on increasing stool frequency in adults: a randomized controlled trial
berichten.samenvatting: Yeast mannans are microbial-available substrates that may improve laxation and specifically modulate gut microbiota composition. The aim of this study is to determine the effect of yeast mannan supplementation on stool frequency in adults. Secondary aims will assess gastrointestinal tolerance and quality of life, whole gut transit time, fecal microbiota composition, and fecal and urinary levels of microbial-generated metabolites.
berichten.kernzin: Een gerandomiseerd gecontroleerd onderzoek onderzocht het effect van gistmannansupplementen op de ontlasting frequentie bij volwassenen.

berichten.titel: Proteomics for cultivated meat: Evaluation of sample preparation methods and analytical workflows for label-free quantitative profiling of cultivated meat proteome
berichten.samenvatting: Cultivated meat production requires robust and validated analytical methods for comprehensive characterization. While transcriptomics-based approaches establish the foundational profile of molecular analysis, proteomics provides a direct estimate of the presence and abundance of proteins in cells and tissues, enhancing the scientific certainty in both product development and safety characterization.
berichten.kernzin: Onderzoekers evalueerden monstervoorbereidingsmethoden voor proteomische profilering van gekweekt vlees om de productontwikkeling en veiligheid te verbeteren.

berichten.titel: Animal vs plant-based processed foods have different effects on body weight: a secondary analysis of a randomized, cross-over trial
berichten.samenvatting: Mediterranean and vegan diets have been extensively studied for health effects. This secondary analysis assessed animal vs plant-based processed foods. We hypothesized that greater intake of minimally processed plant foods and lower intake of animal foods, particularly processed and ultraprocessed, would be associated with lower body weight. In this randomized crossover trial, 62 overweight adults were randomized to a Mediterranean or low-fat vegan diet for 16 weeks, separated by a 4-week washout. Body weight was the primary outcome.
berichten.kernzin: Een secundaire analyse van een studie vergeleek de effecten van dierlijke versus plantaardige bewerkte voeding op het lichaamsgewicht bij 62 volwassenen.

berichten.titel: Exploring a positive screen for eating disorders among 7,993 elite sport pupils in Sweden and its association with everyday food practices, demographics, and sports
berichten.samenvatting: Eating disorders can seriously affect athletes' health and athletic performance. Negative consequences may also arise from suboptimal food practices and barriers in everyday life causing inadequate energy intake. Despite research about eating and health in various athletic populations, large-scale surveys of the Swedish elite sport school system have been lacking. Therefore, this study's first aim was to explore Swedish elite sport pupils' everyday food lives in terms of eating practices and perceived practical barriers to handling their daily food actions.

berichten.titel: Nut Consumption, Kidney Function, Chronic Kidney Disease and Mortality: A Systematic Review
berichten.samenvatting: This systematic review evaluates the association between nut consumption and kidney health outcomes, including kidney function markers and chronic kidney disease (CKD) incidence, prevalence, and mortality. Given the nutritional benefits of nuts and the growing burden of CKD, we aimed to assess whether nut consumption is associated with kidney-related outcomes and to assess the strength and consistency of the available evidence. Recent observational studies and cohort analyses provide emerging but heterogeneous evidence on the relationship between nut intake and kidney outcomes.

berichten.titel_orig: B12, la vitamina que nos suplementamos
berichten.samenvatting_orig: Ni las plantas ni los animales son capaces de generar esta vitamina por sí mismos, por lo que suplementar a los animales explotados para evitar consumirlo nosotros directamente no puede presentarse como una opción "más natural" La B12 o cobalamina es una vitamina de origen microbiano, producida por ciertas bacterias y arqueas, que animales y plantas son incapaces de generar por sí mismos.
